晶片端生成式 AI｜人物消除與場景生成

On-device Generative Vision: Person Removal and Scene Synthesis

自主研發 · 互動技術展示

以可重現的桌面 CPU 實驗比較 MI-GAN 與 Telea 的背景修補輸出，並規劃晶片端模型部署驗證。

建立專案需求 比較 MI-GAN 實際推論結果

產業問題與工程挑戰

人物消除需要補回被遮住的背景。部署到裝置時，輸出品質、模型所需記憶體和運算成本都要評估。 遮罩誤差、微小遮蔽物與跨幀一致性會改變重建品質。NPU Runtime 支援的算子、動態尺寸、精度與記憶體上限會改變部署選擇。

技術方法與架構

實作與交付

用兩張公開領域背景與自行製作的遮罩比較 MI-GAN 和 OpenCV Telea，保留已知乾淨背景作為參照。另保留可調整遮罩邊界的瀏覽器基準。

成果

可切換場景、遮罩與修補輸出。桌面 CPU 結果同時列出延遲與遮罩內品質，揭示紋理差異影響兩種方法的相對表現。

  • 瀏覽器合成影像重建展示
  • 模型轉換與裝置驗證方法
  • 可供討論的品質及效能驗收規格

驗證與證據

兩組測試各暖機 5 次、量測 30 次。ONNX Runtime CPU 使用 4 執行緒、批次 1；計時納入前後處理。以已知乾淨背景計算遮罩內 PSNR。

模型實際輸出

公開模型的背景修補對照

以桌面 CPU 執行 MI-GAN 與 Telea，並用已知乾淨背景計算遮罩內的 PSNR。比較兩組影像、遮罩和重建結果。

Technical Note

On-device Generative Vision: Person Removal and Scene Synthesis

Independent Research and Development · Interactive Demonstration

Compare measured MI-GAN and Telea inpainting on a desktop CPU and scope model deployment on a target device.

繁體中文 Plan a project Compare measured MI-GAN outputs

Industry problem and engineering challenge

Removing a person requires reconstructing the background they covered. Device deployment adds constraints on output quality, memory and compute. Mask error, fine occlusions and frame-to-frame consistency affect reconstruction. Operator compatibility, dynamic dimensions, precision and memory limits also affect NPU deployment.

Technical approach and architecture

Implementation and deliverables

Use two public-domain backgrounds and controlled masks to run MI-GAN and OpenCV Telea. The clean backgrounds serve as references. An adjustable browser baseline is also available.

Outcome

Compare two scenes and their mask, reference and model output. The CPU results show both latency and image quality, including variation across scenes.

  • Browser-based synthetic reconstruction demo
  • Model conversion and device validation methods
  • Quality and performance acceptance criteria

Validation and evidence

Each measured condition uses five warm-ups and 30 runs. ONNX Runtime CPU uses four threads and batch size one. Timings include preprocessing and postprocessing. Masked PSNR uses the clean background.

Measured model output

Public-model inpainting comparison

MI-GAN and Telea ran on a desktop CPU. Known clean backgrounds support masked PSNR for both controlled inputs.

Open evidence and method
  • Compare measured MI-GAN outputs
  • Run the synthetic reconstruction demo

Project status and disclosure

Ownership and status
Independent Research and Development · Interactive Demonstration

Independent R&D reproduced with a public model and shareable inputs. The evidence covers desktop CPU still-image inference. NPU, diffusion, automatic person segmentation and full-video throughput await measurement.
